name: town-props
mood: Northstar Town, a cozy lakeside company town on a bright spring morning. Storybook, handcrafted, premium; lush layered greens, warm wood, black cast iron, weathered stone, brass. Everything sized for a town where a person is about as tall as a lamp post's lower half.

items.prompt: A tall evergreen pine tree: layered drooping boughs in deep forest green with lighter tips toward the light, a straight brown trunk showing at the base, a pointed top.
A fuller, bushier fir tree: dense dark blue-green tiers with a soft snowless sheen, a short brown trunk, slightly rounder silhouette than a pine.
A round leafy linden tree: a big fluffy crown of fresh spring-green leaves in clustered clumps with bright highlights on the upper left, a sturdy brown trunk with a little root flare.
A blossoming cherry tree: a rounded crown of soft pink blossom clusters with a few green leaves, a dark curving trunk, a scatter of petals at its base.
A slender silver birch: a white papery trunk with black marks, an airy oval crown of small light-green leaves.
A pair of slender silver birch trunks growing together, white bark with black marks, a light airy crown of yellow-green leaves.

The Founders' Oak: a majestic ancient oak with a massive gnarled trunk, great spreading limbs and a huge billowing crown of deep green leaves, a ring of moss and wildflowers around its roots. Awe-inspiring and wise.

The Founders' Fountain: a grand three-tier town fountain of pale carved stone with a wide octagonal basin full of clear blue water, a fluted pedestal, two stacked bowls with water spilling from tier to tier, a small brass star on top, lily pads and coins in the basin. It fills its floor diamond.
A charming little lighthouse: a tapered tower with red and white stripes on a base of grey rocks, a black iron gallery rail, a glowing warm lantern room with a domed red cap and a tiny weathervane.
A commemorative rocket statue: a polished bronze-and-orange retro rocket with fins pointing up on a stepped granite plinth with a small brass plaque (no text), a ring of orange flowers at the base.
A black cast-iron Victorian street lamp: a fluted post on a round base, a scrolled crossarm and a four-sided glass lantern with a warm golden glow and a little crown cap.
A classic park bench: warm honey-oak slats on black cast-iron scrollwork ends, a gently curved slatted backrest, long enough for two.
The SAME park bench (honey-oak slats, black cast-iron scrollwork ends, curved slatted backrest).
A wooden town signpost: a stout post with three arrow-shaped direction boards in cream, teal and coral (no letters), a little roof cap and a flower box at the foot.
A round-topped cobalt-blue post box on a short black pedestal, a brass slot and a little brass star emblem.
A black wave-shaped steel bike rack with one mint-green city bike with a wicker basket parked in it.
A round café terrace table with a white marble top and a black iron base, under a big parasol with red and cream stripes and a scalloped edge.
A round café terrace table with a white marble top and a black iron base, under a big parasol with teal and cream stripes and a scalloped edge.
A rustic wooden picnic table with attached benches on both long sides, a red-and-white gingham cloth, a wicker basket and a jug of lemonade on it.
A small wooden rowboat floating on water, painted red with a cream stripe and a honey-oak interior, two oars resting inside. No water drawn.
A small wooden rowboat floating on water, painted sunny yellow with a navy stripe and a honey-oak interior, two oars resting inside. No water drawn.
A clump of lakeside reeds and cattails with brown velvet seed heads and a couple of yellow flag irises.
A round clipped boxwood shrub in fresh green with lighter leaf clusters on top.
A round flowering hydrangea shrub with big blue and pink flower heads among green leaves.
A square raised flower bed with a low stone edging, filled with pink tulips and white daisies, filling its floor diamond.
A square raised flower bed with a low stone edging, filled with yellow daffodils and orange marigolds, filling its floor diamond.
A square raised flower bed with a low stone edging, filled with blue irises and purple lavender, filling its floor diamond.
A square raised flower bed with a low stone edging, filled with red geraniums and white alyssum, filling its floor diamond.

A white Victorian bandstand gazebo: an octagonal wooden platform with two steps, slender white posts with lacy fretwork, a teal-and-white striped conical roof with a brass finial, strings of little lights under the eaves. It fills its floor diamond.
A wooden flower-seller's cart with two big spoked wheels and a striped coral-and-cream canopy, overflowing with buckets of tulips, sunflowers and roses.
A small wooden town notice board with a little shingled roof, a cork panel covered in colourful pinned notes and flyers (no readable text), on two posts.
